items.text:
चातुर्वर्ण्येषु सर्वेषु हितां वक्ष्यामि निष्कृतिम् ।
अगम्या गमने चैव शुद्ध्यै चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
cāturvarṇyeṣu sarveṣu hitāṃ vakṣyāmi niṣkṛtim |
agamyā gamane caiva śuddhyai cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret || 1 ||
items.en: I will now describe an expiation useful for all four varṇas. For sex with a woman one must not approach, one should perform Cāndrāyaṇa to become pure.

items.text:
एकैकं ह्रासयेद्ग्रासं कृष्णे शुक्ले च वर्धयेत् ।
अमावास्यां न भुञ्जीत ह्येष चान्द्रायणो विधिः ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
ekaikaṃ hrāsayedgrāsaṃ kṛṣṇe śukle ca vardhayet |
amāvāsyāṃ na bhuñjīta hyeṣa cāndrāyaṇo vidhiḥ || 2 ||
items.en: Reduce food by one mouthful each day in the dark half of the month and increase it by one in the bright half; eat nothing on the new-moon day. This is the Cāndrāyaṇa rule.

items.text:
कुक्कुटाण्डप्रमाणं तु ग्रासं वै परिकल्पयेत् ।
अन्याथा भावदोषेण न धर्मो न च शुध्यति ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇaṃ tu grāsaṃ vai parikalpayet |
anyāthā bhāvadoṣeṇa na dharmo na ca śudhyati || 3 ||
items.en: Each mouthful should be the size of a hen's egg. Otherwise, through faulty intent, there is no merit and no purification.

items.text:
प्रायश्चित्ते ततश्चीर्णे कुर्याद्ब्रह्मणभोजनम् ।
गोद्वयं वस्त्रयुग्मं च दद्याद्विप्रेषु दक्षिणां ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
prāyaścitte tataścīrṇe kuryādbrahmaṇabhojanam |
godvayaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca dadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇāṃ || 4 ||
items.en: When the atonement is finished, he should feed Brahmins and give them two cows and a pair of cloths as dakṣiṇā.

items.text:
चण्डालीं वा श्वपाकीं वा ह्यभिगच्छति यो द्विजः ।
त्रिरात्रं उपवासित्वा विप्राणां अनुशासनम् ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
caṇḍālīṃ vā śvapākīṃ vā hyabhigacchati yo dvijaḥ |
trirātraṃ upavāsitvā viprāṇāṃ anuśāsanam || 5 ||
items.en: A twice-born man who has sex with a Caṇḍāla or Śvapāka woman should fast for three nights under the Brahmins' direction,
items.note: Caṇḍāla and Śvapāka: groups treated as the lowest outcastes in this text.

items.text:
सशिखं पवनं कृत्वा प्राजापत्यद्वयं चरेत् ।
गोद्वयं दक्षिणां दद्याच्छुद्धिं पाराशरोऽब्रवीत् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
saśikhaṃ pavanaṃ kṛtvā prājāpatyadvayaṃ caret |
godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchuddhiṃ pārāśaro'bravīt || 6 ||
items.en: … shave his head including the tuft, perform two Prājāpatyas, and give two cows as dakṣiṇā. Parāśara declared this purification.
items.note: The text reads 'pavanam'; this is taken as a slip for 'vapanam' (shaving).

items.text:
क्षत्रियो वाथ वैश्यो वा चण्डालीं गच्छतो यदि ।
प्राजापत्यद्वयं कुर्याद्दद्याद्गोमिथुनद्वयं ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
kṣatriyo vātha vaiśyo vā caṇḍālīṃ gacchato yadi |
prājāpatyadvayaṃ kuryāddadyādgomithunadvayaṃ || 7 ||
items.en: If a Kṣatriya or Vaiśya has sex with a Caṇḍāla woman, he should do two Prājāpatyas and give two pairs of cattle (cow and bull).

items.text:
श्वपाकीं वाथ चण्डालीं शूद्रो वा यदि गच्छति ।
प्राजापत्यं चरेत्कृच्छ्रं चतुर्गोमिथुनं ददेत् ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
śvapākīṃ vātha caṇḍālīṃ śūdro vā yadi gacchati |
prājāpatyaṃ caretkṛcchraṃ caturgomithunaṃ dadet || 8 ||
items.en: If a Śūdra has sex with a Śvapāka or Caṇḍāla woman, he should do one Prājāpatya Kṛcchra and give four pairs of cattle.

items.text:
मातरं यदि गच्छेत्तु भगिनीं स्वसुतां तथा ।
एतास्तु मोहितो गत्वा त्रीणि कृच्छ्राणि संचरेत् ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
mātaraṃ yadi gacchettu bhaginīṃ svasutāṃ tathā |
etāstu mohito gatvā trīṇi kṛcchrāṇi saṃcaret || 9 ||
items.en: If a man has sex with his mother, his sister or his own daughter, having gone to them in delusion, he should perform three Kṛcchras,

items.text:
चान्द्रायणत्रयं कुर्याच्छिश्नच्छेदेन शुध्यति ।
मातृष्वसृगमे चैवं आत्ममेढ्रनिकर्तनं ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
cāndrāyaṇatrayaṃ kuryācchiśnacchedena śudhyati |
mātṛṣvasṛgame caivaṃ ātmameḍhranikartanaṃ || 10 ||
items.en: … and three Cāndrāyaṇas; he becomes pure by cutting off his penis. For sex with his mother's sister, the same: cutting off his own organ.

items.text:
अज्ञानेन तु यो गच्छेत्कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणद्वयम् ।
दश गोमिथुनं दद्याच्छुद्धिं पारशरोऽब्रवीत् ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
ajñānena tu yo gacchetkuryāccāndrāyaṇadvayam |
daśa gomithunaṃ dadyācchuddhiṃ pāraśaro'bravīt || 11 ||
items.en: If he did it without knowing, he should perform two Cāndrāyaṇas and give ten pairs of cattle. Parāśara declared this purification.

items.text:
पितृदारान्समारुह्य मातुराप्तां तु भ्रातृजाम् ।
गुरुपात्नीं स्नुषां चैव भ्रातृभार्यां तथैव च ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
pitṛdārānsamāruhya māturāptāṃ tu bhrātṛjām |
gurupātnīṃ snuṣāṃ caiva bhrātṛbhāryāṃ tathaiva ca || 12 ||
items.en: For sex with his father's wife, his mother's close kinswoman, his brother's daughter, his teacher's wife, his daughter-in-law or his brother's wife,

items.text:
मातुलानीं सगोत्रां च प्राजापत्यत्रयं चरेत् ।
गोद्वयं दक्षिणां दद्याच्छुध्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
mātulānīṃ sagotrāṃ ca prājāpatyatrayaṃ caret |
godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchudhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 13 ||
items.en: … his maternal uncle's wife, or a woman of the same gotra, he should do three Prājāpatyas and give two cows as dakṣiṇā. He becomes pure, without doubt.
items.note: Gotra: a family line descended from one ancestral sage; marriage within it is forbidden.

items.text:
पशुवेष्यादिगमने महिष्युष्ट्रीकपीस्तथा ।
खरीं च सूकरीं गत्वा प्राजापत्यव्रतं चरेत् ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
paśuveṣyādigamane mahiṣyuṣṭrīkapīstathā |
kharīṃ ca sūkarīṃ gatvā prājāpatyavrataṃ caret || 14 ||
items.en: For sex with animals or prostitutes, or with a she-buffalo, she-camel, female monkey, she-ass or sow, he should perform the Prājāpatya vow.

items.text:
गोगामी च त्रिरात्रेण गां एकां ब्राह्मणे ददन् ।
महिष्युष्ट्रीखरीगामी त्वहोरात्रेण शुध्यति ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
gogāmī ca trirātreṇa gāṃ ekāṃ brāhmaṇe dadan |
mahiṣyuṣṭrīkharīgāmī tvahorātreṇa śudhyati || 15 ||
items.en: A man who has sex with a cow becomes pure in three nights by giving one cow to a Brahmin; one who does so with a she-buffalo, she-camel or she-ass becomes pure in one day and night.

items.text:
डामरे समरे वापि दुर्भिक्षे वा जनक्षये ।
बन्दिग्राहे भयार्ता वा सदा स्वस्त्रीं निरीक्षयेत् ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
ḍāmare samare vāpi durbhikṣe vā janakṣaye |
bandigrāhe bhayārtā vā sadā svastrīṃ nirīkṣayet || 16 ||
items.en: In riots, war, famine, epidemics, or when taken captive and afraid, a man should always keep watch over his own wife.

items.text:
चण्डालैः सह संपर्कं या नारी कुरुते ततः ।
विप्रान्दश वरान्कृत्वा स्वकं दोषं प्रकाशयेत् ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
caṇḍālaiḥ saha saṃparkaṃ yā nārī kurute tataḥ |
viprāndaśa varānkṛtvā svakaṃ doṣaṃ prakāśayet || 17 ||
items.en: A woman who has had sexual contact with Caṇḍālas should then declare her fault before ten worthy Brahmins.

items.text:
आकण्ठसंमिते कूपे गोमयोदककर्दमे ।
तत्र स्थित्वा निराहारा त्वहोरात्रेण निष्क्रमेत् ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
ākaṇṭhasaṃmite kūpe gomayodakakardame |
tatra sthitvā nirāhārā tvahorātreṇa niṣkramet || 18 ||
items.en: She should stand without food for a day and a night in a pit filled up to her neck with cow-dung, water and mud, and then come out.

items.text:
सशिखं वपनं कृत्वा भुञ्जीयाद्यावकौदनम् ।
त्रिरात्रं उपवासित्वा त्वेकरात्रं जले वसेत् ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
saśikhaṃ vapanaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīyādyāvakaudanam |
trirātraṃ upavāsitvā tvekarātraṃ jale vaset || 19 ||
items.en: After her head is shaved including the tuft, she should eat barley gruel. She should fast for three nights and spend one night in water.

items.text:
शंखपुष्पीलतामूलं पत्रं वा कुसुमं फलम् ।
सुवर्णं पञ्चगव्यं च क्वाथयित्वा पिबेज्जलम् ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
śaṃkhapuṣpīlatāmūlaṃ patraṃ vā kusumaṃ phalam |
suvarṇaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca kvāthayitvā pibejjalam || 20 ||
items.en: She should boil the root, leaf, flower or fruit of the śaṅkhapuṣpī creeper with gold and pañcagavya, and drink that water.
items.note: Pañcagavya: the five cow products (milk, curd, ghee, urine and dung) mixed and used for purification. Śaṅkhapuṣpī: a medicinal creeping plant.

items.text:
एकभक्तं चरेत्पश्चाद्यावत्पुष्पवती भवेत् ।
व्रतं चरति तद्यावत्तावत्संवसते बहिः ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
ekabhaktaṃ caretpaścādyāvatpuṣpavatī bhavet |
vrataṃ carati tadyāvattāvatsaṃvasate bahiḥ || 21 ||
items.en: After that she should eat one meal a day until her next menstruation. As long as she is doing the vow, she lives outside the house.

items.text:
प्रायश्चित्ते ततश्चीर्णे कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ।
गोद्वयं दक्षिणां दद्यच्छुद्धिं पाराशरोऽब्रवीत् ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
prāyaścitte tataścīrṇe kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanam |
godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyacchuddhiṃ pārāśaro'bravīt || 22 ||
items.en: When the atonement is finished, she should feed Brahmins and give two cows as dakṣiṇā. Parāśara declared this purification.

items.text:
चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य नारीणां कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं व्रतम् ।
यथा भूमिस्तथा नारी तस्मात्तां न तु दूषयेत् ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
cāturvarṇyasya nārīṇāṃ kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam |
yathā bhūmistathā nārī tasmāttāṃ na tu dūṣayet || 23 ||
items.en: For women of all four varṇas, the vow is Kṛcchra and Cāndrāyaṇa. A woman is like the earth; therefore one should not condemn her.

items.text:
बन्दिग्राहेण या भुक्ता हत्वा बद्ध्वा बलाद्भयात् ।
कृत्वा सांतपनं कृच्छ्रं शुध्येत्पाराशरोऽब्रवीत् ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
bandigrāheṇa yā bhuktā hatvā baddhvā balādbhayāt |
kṛtvā sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ śudhyetpārāśaro'bravīt || 24 ||
items.en: A woman taken by a captor, by force, by beating or binding, or through fear, becomes pure by performing the Sāntapana Kṛcchra, said Parāśara.

items.text:
सकृद्भुक्ता तु या नारी नेच्छन्ती पापकर्मभिः ।
प्राजापत्येन शुध्येत ऋतुप्रस्रवणेन च ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
sakṛdbhuktā tu yā nārī necchantī pāpakarmabhiḥ |
prājāpatyena śudhyeta ṛtuprasravaṇena ca || 25 ||
items.en: A woman forced once by sinful men against her will becomes pure through the Prājāpatya and her next menstrual flow.

items.text:
पतत्यर्धं शरीरस्य यस्य भार्या सुरां पिबेत् ।
पतितार्धशरीरस्य निष्कृतिर्न विधीयते ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
patatyardhaṃ śarīrasya yasya bhāryā surāṃ pibet |
patitārdhaśarīrasya niṣkṛtirna vidhīyate || 26 ||
items.en: A man whose wife drinks liquor loses half his body. For one who has lost half his body in this way, no expiation is prescribed.

items.text:
गायत्रीं जपमानस्तु कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं चरेत् ।
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकं ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
gāyatrīṃ japamānastu kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret |
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakaṃ || 27 ||
items.en: Reciting the Gāyatrī, he should perform the Sāntapana Kṛcchra: cow urine, cow-dung, milk, curd, ghee and kuśa-water,

items.text:
एकरात्रोपवासश्च कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं स्मृतम् ।
जारेण जनयेद्गर्भं मृतेऽव्यक्ते गते पतौ ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
ekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ smṛtam |
jāreṇa janayedgarbhaṃ mṛte'vyakte gate patau || 28 ||
items.en: … followed by a one-night fast, is known as the Sāntapana Kṛcchra. If a woman conceives by a lover when her husband is dead, missing or gone away,

items.text:
तां त्यजेदपरे राष्ट्रे पतितां पापकारिणीम् ।
ब्राह्मणी तु यदा गच्छेत्परपुंसा समन्विता ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
tāṃ tyajedapare rāṣṭre patitāṃ pāpakāriṇīm |
brāhmaṇī tu yadā gacchetparapuṃsā samanvitā || 29 ||
items.en: … one should abandon her in another country as a fallen, sinful woman. When a Brahmin woman goes off together with another man,

items.text:
सा तु नष्टा विनिर्दिष्टा न तस्यागमनं पुनः ।
कामान्मोहात्तु या गच्छेत्त्यक्त्वा बन्धून्सुतान्पतिं ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
sā tu naṣṭā vinirdiṣṭā na tasyāgamanaṃ punaḥ |
kāmānmohāttu yā gacchettyaktvā bandhūnsutānpatiṃ || 30 ||
items.en: … she is declared lost; there is no coming back for her. A woman who, out of desire or delusion, leaves her relatives, sons and husband and goes away,

items.text:
सा तु नष्टा परे लोके मानुषेषु विशेषतः ।
मदमोहगता नारी क्रोधाद्दण्डादिताडिता ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
sā tu naṣṭā pare loke mānuṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ |
madamohagatā nārī krodhāddaṇḍāditāḍitā || 31 ||
items.en: … is lost in the next world and especially among people. A woman who, overcome by passion or confusion, or beaten with a stick in anger,

items.text:
अद्वितीया गता चैव पुनरागमनं भवेत् ।
दशमे तु दिने प्राप्ते प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
advitīyā gatā caiva punarāgamanaṃ bhavet |
daśame tu dine prāpte prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 32 ||
items.en: … goes away alone, without another man, may come back. If the tenth day is reached, there is no atonement.
items.note: The second half is unclear: it may mean no atonement is needed if she returns within ten days, or that after ten days none is possible.

items.text:
दशाहं न त्यजेन्नारीं त्यजेन्नष्टश्रुतां तथा ।
भर्ता चैव चरेत्कृच्छ्रं कृच्छार्धं चैव बान्धवाः ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
daśāhaṃ na tyajennārīṃ tyajennaṣṭaśrutāṃ tathā |
bhartā caiva caretkṛcchraṃ kṛcchārdhaṃ caiva bāndhavāḥ || 33 ||
items.en: One should not abandon a woman before ten days, but one should abandon a woman of whom nothing more is heard. The husband should do a Kṛcchra and the relatives half a Kṛcchra.

items.text:
तेषां भुक्त्वा च पीत्वा च अहोरात्रेण शुध्यति ।
ब्राह्मणी तु यदा गच्छेत्परपुंसा विवर्जिता ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
teṣāṃ bhuktvā ca pītvā ca ahorātreṇa śudhyati |
brāhmaṇī tu yadā gacchetparapuṃsā vivarjitā || 34 ||
items.en: Anyone who has eaten and drunk with them becomes pure in a day and night. When a Brahmin woman, left by the other man, goes away,
items.note: 'vivarjitā' (left, without) makes this half unclear; it may mean she goes alone or is abandoned by the man.

items.text:
गत्वा पुंसां शतं याति त्यजेयुस्तां तु गोत्रिणः ।
पुंसो यदि गृहे गच्छेत्तदशुद्धं गृहं भवेत् ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
gatvā puṃsāṃ śataṃ yāti tyajeyustāṃ tu gotriṇaḥ |
puṃso yadi gṛhe gacchettadaśuddhaṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet || 35 ||
items.en: … and then goes to a hundred men, her gotra relatives should abandon her. If she enters a man's house, that house becomes impure.
items.note: Meaning of the first half is uncertain; best reading given.

items.text:
पतिमातृगृहं यच्च जारस्यैव तु तद्गृहम् ।
उल्लिख्य तद्गृहं पश्चात्पञ्चगव्येन सेचयेत् ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
patimātṛgṛhaṃ yacca jārasyaiva tu tadgṛham |
ullikhya tadgṛhaṃ paścātpañcagavyena secayet || 36 ||
items.en: Whether it is her husband's house, her mother's house, or the lover's house, that house should be scraped and then sprinkled with pañcagavya.

items.text:
त्यजेच्च मृण्मयं पात्रं वस्त्रं काष्ठं च शोधयेत् ।
संभारान्शोधयेत्सर्वान्गोबालैश्च फलोद्भवान् ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
tyajecca mṛṇmayaṃ pātraṃ vastraṃ kāṣṭhaṃ ca śodhayet |
saṃbhārānśodhayetsarvāngobālaiśca phalodbhavān || 37 ||
items.en: Clay pots should be thrown away, and cloth and wooden things cleaned. All stored goods and things made from plants should be cleaned with cow-hair.

items.text:
ताम्राणि पञ्चगव्येन कांस्यानि दश भस्मभिः ।
प्रायश्चित्तं चरेद्विप्रो ब्राह्मणैरुपपादितम् ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
tāmrāṇi pañcagavyena kāṃsyāni daśa bhasmabhiḥ |
prāyaścittaṃ caredvipro brāhmaṇairupapāditam || 38 ||
items.en: Copper vessels are cleaned with pañcagavya, bronze ones with ash ten times. The Brahmin should perform the atonement laid down by the Brahmins.

items.text:
गोद्वयं दक्षिणां दद्यात्प्राजापत्यद्वयं चरेत् ।
इतरेषां अहोरात्रं पञ्चगव्यं च शोधनम् ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātprājāpatyadvayaṃ caret |
itareṣāṃ ahorātraṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca śodhanam || 39 ||
items.en: He should give two cows as dakṣiṇā and perform two Prājāpatyas. For the others, a day-and-night fast and pañcagavya are the cleansing.

items.text:
उपवासैर्व्रतैः पुण्यैः स्नानसंध्यार्चनादिभिः ।
जपहोमदयादानैः शुध्यन्ते ब्राह्मणादयः ॥ ४० ॥
items.tr:
upavāsairvrataiḥ puṇyaiḥ snānasaṃdhyārcanādibhiḥ |
japahomadayādānaiḥ śudhyante brāhmaṇādayaḥ || 40 ||
items.en: Brahmins and the others are purified by fasts, vows, good deeds, bathing, sandhyā prayers, worship, japa, homa, compassion and giving.
items.note: Japa: repeated recitation of a mantra. Homa: an offering into the sacred fire.

items.text:
आकाशं वायुरग्निश्च मेध्यं भूमिगतं जलम् ।
न प्रदुष्यन्ति दर्भाश्च यज्ञेषु चमसा यथा ॥ ४१ ॥
items.tr:
ākāśaṃ vāyuragniśca medhyaṃ bhūmigataṃ jalam |
na praduṣyanti darbhāśca yajñeṣu camasā yathā || 41 ||
items.en: Sky, wind, fire, and pure water lying on the ground never become impure, nor does darbha grass, just like the camasa cups used in sacrifices.
items.note: Camasa: wooden cups used for Soma in Vedic sacrifice. Darbha: the same as kuśa grass.
